title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Sound Devices 744T > Adobe Audition CC 2015 >Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic four‑set 1970 show, highlighted by stellar acoustic numbers and a soaring electric second set
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the balanced, crisp SBD that makes you feel like you're in the room, while praising the unique half‑acoustic/half‑electric flow – from the intimate Riders in‑the‑sky acoustic set to the fierce, sublime electric jams. Standout moments include Friend of the Devil, Dire Wolf and a soaring Uncle John’s Band, though a few tracks suffer minor reel‑flip glitches and occasional out‑of‑tune bits.

ai_rating.rationale: Over ten detailed reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5 stars, cite superb performance and a high‑quality soundboard; only one low rating mentions technical gaps, so the weighted average leans strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix with excellent timbre; minor issues noted include occasional reel‑flip gaps, a few mono sections and slight speed/pitch quirks on some bootleg transfers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed acoustic set (with NRPS guests) opens, followed by a Riders‑in‑the‑sky mini‑set, then two powerful electric sets that build to a cosmic climax; the pacing is praised as both funky and cosmic, capturing the 1970 tour vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his soaring guitar tone and 'journey over the mountain' feel; highlighted on acoustic numbers and electric jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted on amplified bass during Cumberland Blues and generally solid, though some reviewers felt his presence faded in certain mixes.
